animation_tiles.method: --bench-browser: the animation page (a canvas covering the view, redrawn every animation frame) in a 1600x1000 tab of eludite-chromium (CEF 154, windowless, software OnPaint, --disable-gpu); frames through the memfd ring; the shell draws each with img from a new RenderImage. frame_cost = DockHost render to the end of its present for every shell frame in the window; upload = RenderImage creation (copy out of shared memory); img_paint = the img element's paint in frames with a new image (GPUI's atlas insert, its staging copy); latency = engine OnPaint to the end of the present that showed the frame (CLOCK_MONOTONIC)
animation_tiles.page: animation: a canvas covering the view, redrawn every animation frame

tiles.method: brief 0032's partial uploads: the frame as 256x256 tiles, each its own RenderImage; a frame following the last uploaded one re-creates only the tiles its dirty rectangles touch (ELUDITE_BROWSER_TILES=0: one image per frame)

frame_split.method: each frame with a new image split at the end of the img element's paint: render to the image painted (layout, prepaint, the upload, the paint so far: CPU) and the image painted to the end of the present (the rest of the paint and the present: here Mesa's software rasterizer and the texture copy)

baseline_no_upload.method: the same window redrawn every 16 ms with the last image, nothing uploaded
